correctness.rationale: An exact support-and-double-label characterization gives an if-and-only-if condition for each attack. Two distinct standalone programs enumerate all functions of weight <=8 on isomorphic eighteen-vertex Pappus graphs and agree: none below eight, 1755+882+54 optima. The affine checker exhaustively proves full automorphism group order 216 by checking all 9! point permutations; it computes 20 symmetry orbits, all transfer edges and exact BFS distance/eccentricity data for every function. Both programs were executed from packaged source.

value.rationale: Weak Roman guard defense is a motivated classic domination model; the Pappus graph is a canonical eighteen-vertex 3-regular incidence graph. It is meaningful that duplicated guards create 936 new optimizers but no lower weight, and that adding their legal transfers preserves connectivity yet changes sharp jump/slide diameters to 9 and 12. The result is the complete natural finite optimizer and symmetry/mobility classification, not an arbitrary slice or rebranding of the known secure binary case.
